idea: a pull can lock two blocks face to face: each magnet drags a block into a lane where it meets a block pointing back at it - each magnet must wait until that block has left, and must still go before the block it is holding up
family: D magnet displacement (two magnets, face-to-face pulls)
redesign: round 1 (MG2: one magnet + lock) reached 2 distinct mistakes; two magnets, each pulling a block into a face-to-face deadlock if fired early
